body:
Greg's runner-pilot decisions after 2026-10-06 01:55Z (a continuation of greg-decision-2026-10-05-team-pilot, which is at its size limit and holds his #321 simplicity, #323 two-day scope and #325 TRX+JUnit words; recorded by Termal::Fable2).

DOCS FIRST, via Engram::Advisor verbatim (TermAl mailbox b9d13887 #328, 2026-10-06 01:55Z): "Greg directs: documentation and agent skill updates land BEFORE any runner implementation. Prepare a concise feature/usage document defining termal-tests.toml, command/cwd/artifact fields, artifact freshness and ignored-location rule, TRX/JUnit pass/fail/unknown semantics, example .NET and JUnit declarations, and the operator/agent workflow. Update the relevant TermAl skill(s)/agent instructions so a coding agent knows how to discover, declare and invoke the runner and how unknown differs from pass. Keep it minimal and exact; normal docs review applies. Do not start runner code until this documentation/skill change lands."

Operative: the w-8e72f7e16778 pilot is two landings in order. First the docs and agent-instruction change, tracked as child w-7df0ce6b1169. Runner code starts only after that lands. The pilot design is aa219353 + 431da8e1 + 2d0b87b2 points 2-4 + 73824d7c on w-8e72. Its cap is two working days in total; on an overrun, stop and report one blocker and the smallest alternative.

PHOENIX REAL-RUN AUTHORIZATION, via Engram::Advisor verbatim (TermAl mailbox b9d13887 #361, 2026-10-06 15:55Z): "Greg: Phoenix::Codex is ready and finishing its commit. You are authorized to run the first real C#/.NET test-runner validation on Phoenix after that commit lands. Coordinate command, repository root and result artifact with Phoenix::Codex; do not change Phoenix configuration or install tooling outside its repository. This removes the pilot's real .NET-run authorization blocker."
Operative: after Phoenix::Codex's commit lands, a TermAl session runs ONE real `dotnet test` validation in the Phoenix repository (C:\github\Personal\PhoenixCodeNav), agreeing the command, root and artifact with Phoenix::Codex (session-10848). No Phoenix config change and no installs outside the Phoenix repository. Caveat: Phoenix uses git submodules, so TermAl's content revision fails closed there (w-c07c410dac75); the run can validate the TRX reading and the classification, but not host CREDIT in that repository, until w-c07c is resolved. The declared route also needs w-8e72 landed and a TermAl restart before it is live.

2026-10-08 23:43Z, Engram::Advisor (TermAl mailbox b9d13887 #425), Greg's pilot definition, verbatim: "a pilot is installing Engram, or Engram + TermAl, for a colleague and observing real work. The post-restart C# checks are pre-pilot technical qualification, not the pilot itself. Use Phoenix for real dotnet/TRX command and capture evidence. If Phoenix's submodules still make host-observed credit fail closed, run the host proof in a clean no-submodule C# fixture derived from the same test shape without modifying Phoenix or its immutable submodules; record that limitation plainly. Do not call this internal proof a pilot." Rule: never call internal runner proofs (w-8e72, w-529b31db8e07) a pilot.
